Mobile Hardware & Management: Demonstrable experience managing and troubleshooting Android and iOS mobile devices/tablets at scale in an enterprise, testing, or lab setting. Tools & Process: Direct operational experience using Jira for ticket lifecycle tracking and Confluence for technical documentation. Problem Solving: Strong analytical troubleshooting skills with a proactive approach to resolving OS and infrastructure issues. Work Environment & Physical Demands 100% Onsite: Requires daily on-premise presence at the Navi Mumbai facility. Physical Ability: Comfortable working with rack-mounted equipment, mobile testing racks, and routine physical cable routing.
